name: xmrj-solana
comment: The Solana workspace's test harness. Versions here are EXACT (no carets) for the same reason the crates use `=`: this repo pins every tool it builds with, and test_anchor_wiring.py section 14 fails if @anchor-lang/core drifts from Anchor.toml's [toolchain] anchor_version. `@anchor-lang/core` is the renamed client package (was @coral-xyz/anchor before Anchor 1.0.0).
